source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the DIMM information and detail information

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL pretty-printed JSON from /redfish/v1/Systems/system/Memory (DIMM slot inventory) so user can read/diff against SPEC for "DIMM slot". No RISK (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES assumes one system/collection shape and reports only MemorySummary plus a DIMM count, with curl -k and no physical slot, member, health or empty-slot validation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED requires complete per-DIMM topology, population, capacity, health and empty/disabled semantics under a read-only boundary.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 968/2291 accepts summary/count output as directly runnable.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: UBB_FPGA inventory and fan telemetry do not establish memory socket population or per-module details.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves WebUI evidence; ED-34 permits approved inventory sources; ED-35 rejects summary/count coverage reduction; ED-36 treats socket map/reference as readiness.

original_test_intent: Verify every DIMM slot's BMC inventory/detail information is readable and correct.
original_method: Enumerate the complete memory collection, bind logical members and documented empty slots to the physical socket/channel topology, normalize capacity/type/speed/state/health/errors, and compare each slot with WebUI and the approved build recipe without physical intervention.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the socket/channel population recipe and expected field/state rules. The agent may enumerate and compare protected records; physical mapping exceptions and final verdict remain engineer-owned.
safety_requirements: Do not inject memory faults, reseat modules, change memory configuration, power-cycle or reset.
Do not accept summary/count as slot-level proof.
Use trusted transport and protected credentials.
Distinguish empty, disabled, absent and failed slots.
Stop on duplicate/ambiguous socket mapping or stale health without automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve the exact ComputerSystem and complete Memory collection/pages.
Map each member and expected empty socket to physical CPU/channel/slot.
Collect redacted capacity, type, speed, state, health, errors and timestamps.
Correlate every slot with WebUI and build reference.
Return evidence only with no physical/configuration change.
engineer_actions: Approve field, health and empty-slot semantics.
Review discrepancies and issue formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Insufficient: summary plus count cannot prove slot identity, topology, per-DIMM values, empty sockets, health or pagination; TLS trust is disabled.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Follow the actual Memory collection and normalize every member against the physical slot map, including documented empty/disabled slots.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: DIMM slot, WebUI detail inspection, Criterion and original time values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform complete topology-bound per-slot memory inventory reconciliation under no-fault/no-reseat controls.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, Redfish Memory schema and parser versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor memory topology and Project hardware recipe.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete collection traversal, physical mapping and per-slot state semantics while retaining WebUI verification.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: MemorySummary and DIMM count are aggregate partial evidence and cannot establish every physical slot's correctness.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Slot map, population recipe and per-field/state expectations.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Logical member ordering may differ from silk-screen labels, and stale health can hide a failed or missing module.

project_override_considerations: Alternate memory inventory tools require physical slot equivalence, complete populated/empty coverage, engineer approval and explicit disclosure of uncovered WebUI/Redfish fields.
expected_evidence: Complete Memory collection and CPU/channel/slot map
Raw redacted per-DIMM records and timestamps

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently requests DIMM detail correctness; the aggregate DeepSeek command is incomplete coverage, not a conflicting purpose.

blocked_analysis.analysis: DIMM inventory intent is clear; topology, population and expected values are Project readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Replaces summary/count with complete per-slot topology and health comparison.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid classification and read-only safety boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Adds coverage completeness, physical identity and empty-slot semantics missing from direct-run review.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps memory coverage separate from firmware and cooling inventory.

review_improvement: Prevents correct aggregate capacity/count from masking a misplaced, degraded, missing or misidentified DIMM.
independent_technical_reasoning: Aggregate memory totals can remain correct when modules occupy wrong sockets or when topology labels are mismapped. A valid SIT check must reconcile each logical member with physical CPU/channel/slot identity and explicitly account for empty or disabled sockets without disturbing hardware.
